children: Drinks giant Diageo can look to stronger growth in emerging markets, analysts at Bernstein write in a note. The London-listed group behind Guinness stout and Smirnoff vodka set out new guidance for the coming years this month, and looks set for better-than-expected organic growth in the Rest of World segment, Bernstein says. The group can also expects higher cost savings as part of an operational overhaul, the brokerage says. Bernstein trims its target price on the stock to 24.90 pounds from 25.50. Shares open 1% higher at 17.19 pounds. (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
